explanation: This unit is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every rewarded D1, and everywhere before about trial 82; it fires only at D1 steps that follow an unrewarded trial near the end of the episode (trials about 85-99), where it is usually 5-10 (often 9-10 by about trial 92 or after two or three losses in a row, about 5-6 for a single loss around trials 82-90). About a third of these late unrewarded D1 steps still stay at 0, more often when the unrewarded trial came right after a choice switch or a rare transition.
